scale_bound.note: even a FULL capture of the 90th-percentile weekday gap is below the modeled RT floor on both legs

verdict.verdict: YES — under EVERY committed dispersion reading the modeled RT floor meets or exceeds the minimum detectable effect at program-feasible n: Reading A (the §4.7 daily-sigma upper bound, the LEAST corrected reading) gives r = 0.99-1.74 (6E) / 1.46-2.60 (6B) at the census n — r >= 1 except the single most favorable cell (6E low tier 0.99, i.e. an effect exactly at MDE nets ~0); Reading B (corrected gap-std scale) gives r = 15-27 (6E) / 20-36 (6B); the gap-percentile bound puts the p95 weekday gap (3.10bp 6E / 4.40bp 6B — verify in JSON) below the RT floors. Threshold thinning (§4.5 registered-cycle decision) only lowers n and worsens every r; the 17:00-CT spread is disclosed as likely MOST biased-low (thinnest window) so the RT floor is more likely understated than overstated. This is the M2c-corrected power-honesty arithmetic — it adjudicates no §4 refutation condition and schedules nothing.
